description:
Cast Genghis Frog either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Arcane Adaptation, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat step 3.
